g.text: One project owns its stages and allowed moves.
Boards keep filters and per-stage WIP overrides.
Metadata, workflow and ordering have separate revisions.
Image drafts and published files have explicit typed states.
Detach keeps historical comment references readable.
These boxes are feature responsibilities within one backend.
Supporting history, retry and delivery tables are retained.
